qcReview.tool: scripts/data/qc_render.py <packId> <outDir> [--crop]: decodes the packed DICOM and draws every reference target on it (contour sets on the image with the largest outlined area), so a shifted, flipped or misplaced outline would show
qcReview.selectionRule: NIH ChestX-ray14 PA films of adults (18-90) with a radiologist box whose label is also in the report labels, one film per patient, patients of cxr-findings excluded. Pass A ranked like round 1 (fewest other labels, box area capped), 104 candidates; pass B ranked by box area (up to a quarter of the film), 92 candidates.
qcReview.review: Every one of the 196 candidates drawn with its boxes (full film and zoom; contrast-equalised crops for subtle pneumothoraces, effusions and nodules) and kept only where the boxed finding is clearly visible: 67 kept.
